groups.meta: ~250,000 standing across 5 rank-ups plus the blueprint

rows.label: rank-ups to Old Mate
rows.note: Rank 5; 5,000 / 22,000 / 44,000 / 70,000 / 99,000 per rank, plus Debt-Bonds and 385,000 credits

conditions: Daily cap is 16,000 standing plus 500 per Mastery Rank.
The free vendor item at each rank-up can cover the Cryotra blueprint at Old Mate, but a pricier Rank 5 item is the better use of it.
bonuses: Conservation with the best echo-lure and pheromones is the fastest standing, near-unanimous across threads; once Old Mate, a Kubrodon lure hits the daily cap in under half an hour.
Ivara (Prowl) or Equinox/Titania with Sleep subsumed get reliable perfect captures; shooting from Archwing before the animal notices also works.
Mining and fishing turn-ins at Smokefinger and The Business work too if gems or fish are already stockpiled.

disclosures.title: before Old Mate
disclosures.body: The rarest lures, like Kubrodon, aren't purchasable until Old Mate; it shows up wild for roughly 2,000 standing in the meantime.

rows.label: Training, Shelter, Medical, Advances and Familial Debt-Bonds

conditions: Check Ticker twice a day; rare bond tiers are the real bottleneck on the rank-up math.
bonuses: Profit-Taker drops every Debt-Bond tier once that fight is available.
The Exploiter Orb (Thermia Fractures) drops gems to trade in for standing and doubles as a Charamote Sagan Module source.

conditions: Untradeable; Legs is the only source.
